entities.summary: Philipp Poisel (b. 1983-06-18, Ludwigsburg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ludwigsburg and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
